options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The endpoint URL of the Cloud Foundry API.

options.name: metadata
options.description: A dictionary containing metadata for the service instance.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the service instance.

options.name: parameters
options.description: A dictionary containing configuration parameters for the service instance.

options.name: password
options.description: The password for authentication with the Cloud Foundry API.

options.name: service
options.description: The name of the service offering.

options.name: service_plan
options.description: The name of the service plan for the service instance.

options.name: space
options.description: The name of the space in which to manage the service instance.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the service instance.

options.name: username
options.description: The username for authentication with the Cloud Foundry API. This is SAP BTP user email address
